text:
maya: Heads-up — CI on master is red, ~12 failing e2e jobs. Looks like a common failure hitting the eventbus mock with 503s. I kicked a rerun for the affected matrix: https://ci.redwood.com/p/2401

infra-bot: [automated] pipeline #2401 failed: integration:eventflow (matrix 7/12). Logs: https://ci.redwood.com/p/2401/logs

priya: saw it, starting a quick rerun for the failed shards now (rerun command queued).

jun: pinging @sam — could be infra (mock image or network) or a regression in the stub. Any alerts from the test cluster?

sam: looking into test-kube. The mock-eventbus pod is flapping with 503s to /publish. grabbing logs now. snippet: ```ERROR 2026-03-17T14:07:22Z [http] 503 "Service Unavailable" - downstream timeout```. Also seeing repeated `ConnectionResetError` from the mock.

maya: failing tests (examples): `integration/tests/eventflow/test_replay.py::test_reliable_delivery`, `integration/tests/ingest/test_backpressure.py::test_kv_ack`, `e2e/chat_retry.test.js::should_recover_on_publish_503` — all failing with publish 503 or timeout.

priya: rerun completed for the same shard, still fails. Not a transient flake.

jun: can we bisect recently merged changes that touch mocks or image tags? @priya can you run `./scripts/ci-bisect --since=main~10 --target=integration/eventflow` to find first bad commit?

priya: starting bisect. If it's infra image, patching to previous tag might be fastest.

sam: checking registry history — mock-eventbus image moved from `mock-eventbus:1.3.4` -> `1.3.5` yesterday (by #1782). 1.3.5 changelog mentions HTTP client refactor.

priya: bisect step 2/7: reproduces on commit `a9f3e1` (PR #1782). Suspect new client caused behavior change under load.

jun: thanks. If we pin to 1.3.4 for CI, should get green quickly. We can also revert the client change in the mock if needed.

sam: rolled test cluster to `mock-eventbus:1.3.4` and restarted pods. Running a targeted rerun for the failing matrix now.

ci-bot: [automated] rerun triggered for pipeline #2401 (shard 7/12) by sam.

priya: rerun reporting — all previously failing tests in that shard passed on pin. Running remaining shards to be safe.

maya: excellent. Can we land a quick revert PR to pin CI image and follow up with a fix for the client refactor in the mock?

jun: I'll open a hotfix PR to pin the CI deployment and add an integration test to catch client-side timeouts. @sam can you review?

sam: will review shortly. Also adding an alert to oncall for mock-eventbus 5xx rate > 1% in test-kube.

maya: last shard finished, full matrix is green. Closing this thread — thanks for the quick triage :thumbsup: 

ci-bot: [automated] pipeline #2401 all green. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.com/p/2401/artifacts

maya: Note for postmortem: root cause = mock-eventbus client refactor in `mock-eventbus:1.3.5` causing 503s under our test load; mitigation = pin to 1.3.4 in CI + hotfix PR. Follow-up: add regression test and update mock client with backoff handling.
